method: Randomized A-P sheet; three isolated reviewers, no prompts/order/answers shown; strict majority per axis

locomotion.label: A
locomotion.reason: Muzzle turns right and lowers toward chest; both pupils sit low-right.

locomotion.label: B
locomotion.reason: Snout points right with a slight downward pitch; pupils are toward lower-right eye edges.

locomotion.label: C
locomotion.reason: Raised muzzle projects left; pupils and visible eye surfaces aim upper-left.

locomotion.label: D
locomotion.reason: Centered symmetric raised snout, chin exposed, both pupils high under upper lids.

locomotion.label: E
locomotion.reason: Snout and pupils point left; head pitch and eye height appear approximately level.

locomotion.label: F
locomotion.reason: Muzzle lifts strongly toward left; eyes look high-left above the snout.

locomotion.label: G
locomotion.reason: Head turns left with slightly raised snout; pupils sit above-left within the eyes.

locomotion.label: H
locomotion.reason: Forehead dominates while muzzle points down slightly left; both pupils gather low-left.

locomotion.label: I
locomotion.reason: Lowered muzzle angles left; pupils aim toward lower-left corners.

locomotion.label: J
locomotion.reason: Strong rightward snout and gaze, with an approximately level nose and eye line.

locomotion.label: K
locomotion.reason: Symmetric bowed head and centered nose; both pupils lie low toward the chest.

locomotion.label: L
locomotion.reason: Snout points right and slightly upward; pupils sit high-right in visible eyes.

locomotion.label: M
locomotion.reason: Nose angles down-right and pupils look low-right beneath lowered brow.

locomotion.label: N
locomotion.reason: Head pitches upward and right, showing chin; pupils are high-right.

locomotion.label: O
locomotion.reason: Muzzle turns slightly left and downward; larger visible eye aims low-left.

locomotion.label: P
locomotion.reason: Muzzle turns right with upward tilt; pupils are directed upper-right.
